note: Transient RV park on US-50 between Pueblo and Canon City (~mile marker 298), in open prairie with mountain views. Unheated pool (Memorial Day - Labor Day, weather permitting). The well water is high in iron and minerals: bring an RV water filter and bottled drinking water. --Claude
